<<NOTES ON TENDING A ROOFTOP BEEHIVE>>  
TEND A ROOFTOP BEEHIVE FOR A NEIGHBORHOOD NEWSLETTER.  
USE CAPITAL LETTERS.  
KEEP UNDER 110 WORDS.  

THE BEES HONEY THE AIR, AND THE NEIGHBORS THANK ME.  
THEY SEE THE BEEHIVE AS A SYMBOL OF HOPE AND COMMUNITY.  
I AM GRATEFUL FOR THE OPPORTUNITY TO SHARE THIS STORY.  

[MAP SHEET] SHOWS THE LOCATION OF THE BEEHIVE.  
[JOE'S JAR LABEL] IS A FAVORITE OF THE NEIGHBORS.  
[SONG TITLE] IS PLAYED AT THE NEXT MEETING.  
[SHELF LETTER] IS THE HIGHLIGHT OF THE NEWSLETTER.
